steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Octavian (later Augustus) was Caesar's adopted heir who defeated Mark Antony at Actium (31 BC) to become Rome's sole ruler | Key Fact: The Second Triumvirate (43 BC): Octavian, Antony and Lepidus divided the Roman world; it ended in civil war between Octavian and Antony | Key Fact: Augustus established the Principate: he held supreme power but maintained Republican forms and titles (Princeps = First Citizen) | Key Fact: The constitutional settlement (27 BC): Augustus 'restored the Republic' but kept consulship, tribunician power and control of key provinces

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from augustus &amp; the principate, and one past-paper question.
